nodes.description: Product photo of Optimum Nutrition (ON) Gold Standard 100% Whey protein powder, Double Rich Chocolate flavor, 908g (2lb) container with 29 servings. Contains 24g protein, 5.5g BCAAs, and 4g glutamine per serving. Black container with red and gold label.
